name: Alkemi Earn self-liquidation collateral inflation
summary: AlkemiEarn.liquidateBorrow() let a borrower liquidate their own position with the borrowed asset also serving as the collateral asset, crediting more supply than the repayment consumed, so a flash-loaned supply/borrow/self-liquidate/withdraw sequence walked out with more ETH than was deposited.
notes: The last implementation change before the exploit installed the vulnerable code; later storage writes are user activity and an admin handover.
Six copycats self-liquidated within 210 blocks, one seizing WBTC collateral; a seventh self-liquidation moved no assets and is not listed.
Alkemi's WETH wrapper 0x8125afd0 has no DefiLlama price; it redeems 1:1 for ETH, so it is valued at the ETH price at the anchor.
